## 6. Submission Verification Checklist

Please verify and check every item before requesting review:

- [ ] **Folder Structure:** My submission is placed in a single new directory under `submissions/<project-slug>/` copied from `submissions/_template/`.
- [ ] **Naming Conventions:** The `<project-slug>` uses lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, matching the branch name and PR title.
- [ ] **Complete Documentation:** Both `submissions/<project-slug>/README.md` and `submissions/<project-slug>/architecture.md` are completely filled out without unfilled placeholder markers.
- [ ] **Metadata File:** `submissions/<project-slug>/submission.json` is completed and valid JSON.
- [ ] **No Secrets or Credentials:** No API keys, passwords, private tokens, or connection strings with real credentials are committed. `.env.example` contains placeholders only.
- [ ] **Tested Setup Instructions:** Setup and run instructions were tested from a fresh environment and can be reproduced by reviewers.
- [ ] **License Declared:** Open-source license or distribution terms are specified.
- [ ] **Code of Conduct:** All team members agree to adhere to the repository [Code of Conduct](../../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] **Scope Isolation:** This PR only adds/modifies files inside `submissions/<project-slug>/` and does not touch root files or other submissions.
- [ ] **Google Form Submission:** I understand that opening this PR is step 1, and I will submit this PR URL into the official Google Form (**[GOOGLE_FORM_LINK_TO_BE_ADDED]**).
